headline: This law lets the President posthumously award the Medal of Honor to Alwyn C. Cashe for acts of valor during Operation Iraqi Freedom.
what_it_does: It gives the President authority to award the Medal of Honor, the country's highest military honor, to Alwyn C. Cashe after his death. The award is for actions taken during Operation Iraqi Freedom. The official summary does not describe any other changes.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 4, 2020.
